name: SEMANTIC_DOMAIN_SHIFT_LOGIC
description: Shifts the domain from spatial networks (factions, treaties, paths) to formal logic (propositions, equivalences, proofs). This obscures the geometric "tree" nature of the data. Models typically associate "equivalences" with Disjoint Set Union (DSU) or Kruskal's algorithm. If a model applies DSU/Kruskal's to connect the core propositions, it will greedily include cheap but irrelevant equivalences (dead-end branches), resulting in an incorrect oversized sum, thus failing the test.
